name: n8n
description: Codex plugin for exploring n8n workflows, reviewing executions, and applying full workflow JSON updates with local backups.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect, back up, and update n8n workflows from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to an n8n instance through a local MCP server so you can discover workflows, inspect workflow details, review execution history, apply full workflow JSON updates, and keep local rollback backups before each change.
defaultPrompt: Replace workflow 123 with this JSON and keep a backup.
